network_access.failure: Refuse private-data inference when required isolation cannot be established; never silently allow external network access

policy.ipc_layers: A provider-profile Unix socket may terminate at the Commonstar gateway; that gateway alone calls the private loopback llama worker with its separate API key
policy.api_key_delivery: Protected file generated at setup, never a command-line literal or repository value
policy.configuration_environment: Construct an allowlisted environment; reject inherited upstream tool, download, cache and tunnel options
policy.embedding_policy: A separate reviewed embedding worker and manifest, not this generative worker's hidden extra service
policy.profile_switch: Terminate the old learner worker and clear request state before loading a different learner profile

profiles.model_artifact: Exact checkpoint, quantization, license and SHA-256 are resolved from the project's verified model manifest
profiles.modalities: Text initially; image/audio projectors require separate validated model-pack capabilities

embedding_profile.execution_dtype_policy: BF16 or F32 supported execution only; reject FP16 conversion or fallback
embedding_profile.worker_mode: Separate local embedding process with --embedding enabled and only its required embedding route
embedding_profile.network_access: External outbound traffic denied; authenticated private Unix or configured loopback IPC permitted
embedding_profile.scheduling: Batched indexing pauses while generative inference runs; lexical retrieval remains available
embedding_profile.vector_store: SQLCipher with sqlite-vec; extension and encrypted-database compatibility must be verified
embedding_profile.artifact_identity: Exact file revision, SHA-256 and license are supplied by the verified project model manifest
embedding_profile.validation: Metadata researched only; no artifact download, execution, finite-output check or retrieval-quality measurement performed

release_validation: Compile pinned source for each supported CPU/GPU backend and capture compiler, flags and binary hash
Confirm all selected argv flags in built --help output; refuse startup on unsupported flags
Load each exact model artifact and validate its chat template, tokenizer, stop conditions and structured output behavior
Test context allocation and latency with actual 8192/16384/32768 profiles rather than inferring runtime RAM from weight-file size
Reject unauthorized routes, unauthenticated requests, malicious browser origins and environment overrides
Verify external outbound connections are denied while the approved local IPC request and response still work
Prove the runtime cannot read vault files or launch shell/file tools
Inspect configured logging, crash/core handling, swap and cache persistence with synthetic data
Record upstream security review and project model-quality evaluation before promoting this research pin to a release lock
